raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The payments-source feed renamed status POSTED to SETTLED on 2026-01-16 with unchanged meaning, and the silver filter still requires status = 'POSTED'. Batches 12-14 (ingested from 2026-01-17 onward) therefore contain no POSTED rows and nothing reaches silver. Treating SETTLED as equivalent to POSTED and keeping REVERSED excluded restores the original semantics.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
